title: Gaussian orthogonality of Hermite polynomials
statement: For natural numbers $j$ and $k$, the standard Gaussian integral of the product of the degree-$j$ and degree-$k$ Hermite polynomials is $j!$ when $j=k$, and $0$ otherwise.
